chapter: Hampton, New York and Lee's own band
title: Billy Berg's moves to the Trouville; Billie Holiday works with the band
summary: Billy Berg's next club, the Trouville on Beverly across from CBS, had Billie Holiday and Jimmy Rowles with Lee's band on a late schedule.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: Then we went to Cafe Society -- and we stayed at Cafe Society I think for 3 months. Wait a second. No, I missed a point in there ... because before we went back to New York, Billy Berg had had another club, and that club was -- oh, incidentally, what I missed over at Billy Berg's -- Slim and Lemon Slam used to work there with us. I think that would be interesting to you.
Yeah, yeah. Billy Berg's at Pico. Now, when he went to a club that he called the [Troyville] which is right across from -- it's on Beverly, just off Fairfax -- did you know where the Troyville was?
Yeah, I know where it is, but I can't think of the name of the street.
Okay. No, it's on Beverly Boulevard.
Right, but Beverly and what, I can't remember.
Well, it's right across the street from where -- is that NBC or CBS?
Right across the street from CBS. That's where the Trouville was.

That's right, and this is where Lady Day worked with us. Oh yeah, oh yeah -- she worked there for several weeks. Billy Holiday. But at this time, Jimmy Rowles was playing piano with me then. Okay. So when Jimmy Rowles first came to town, he worked with Lee Lester Young's band, and Bumps and Red and Louis Gonzales.

So we worked at the Trouville for awhile, and -- that was a real good job. We didn't go to work until 10 o'clock at night. We played at 10, and we -- you know, off at 10:30 and go back at 11, you know, go back on at 12, go back on at 1, and stay until 1:30, and that was the end of our gig.
